resources.string: I don\'t know: use typical values
Some values need attention: see the marked fields.

This app tells you when to charge your electric car, so that as much of its power as possible comes from your own solar panels. It needs a few facts about your home and your car, and takes a few minutes.

%1$s, the forecast provider, gets your home\'s location and time zone and the tilt and direction of your panels, to make the forecast. The place you type in the next step goes to %1$s too, to find it. Like any website, %1$s also sees your phone\'s internet address.
While the app is closed, it also asks %1$s about once an hour, so it can tell you before a charge window starts.
Nothing else leaves your phone. There is no account and no tracking.
Other forecast providers and API keys are in Settings.
Press “I don\'t know: use typical values”. The app then uses a typical value, which you can change here or later in Settings.
Searching sends it to %1$s, which finds the coordinates and the time zone.
